********SOME EFFECTIVE INFORMATION ABOUT OLD CURRICULUM *******
**** NSU BBA course plan ****
****Course u have to do to become a Business graduate (BBA) ****
****#Applicable_before_143_Batch****
CORE COURSES (MANDATORY FOR EVERYONE):
*ENG-102 *MAT-112
ACT-201, ACT 202, ECO/BUS-134, ECO/BUS-244, BUS-172, BUS-173, BUS-251, BUS/PHI-401, ECO-101, ECO-104,FIN-254, LAW-200, MGT-314, MGT-321, MGT-351, MGT/INB-372, MGT-368, MGT-489 MIS-105, MIS-205, MKT-202,MGT- 210
General Education (GED) courses:
ENG-103,105
Basic Sciences (3 credits): BIO 103, or CHE 101, or PHY 107 or PBH-101
Environmental Studies (3 credits): ENV 107 or ENV 214
Liberal Arts & Social Sciences (6 credits; 2 courses to be selected from the following): POL 101/ POL 202/ PAD 201/ POL 104/ SOC 101/ SOC 103/ SOC 201/ PAD 201 / BEN 205/ANT 101 /ANT 103/HIS 101/ HIS 202/ HIS 203/ HIS 205/ PHI 101/ PHI 102/ PHI 104/ PSY 101/ PSY 201/ CHN 104/ TNM 201/ WMS 201/CHN-101/LBA-101,104
Concentration Electives (18 credits):
::::::::: Major & Prerequisites ::::::::
#Fin & Act = (Prerequisite Fin254 & Act202)
Mandatory Course- ACT330. FIN435, FIN440.
Additional Course- ACT322. ACT333, ACT341, ACT431, FIN340, FIN433, FIN444, FIN464, FIN470, FIN475, FIN480. ( U have to do any 3 course from here for major & 1 for minor)
#HRM = (Prerequisite MGT351)
Mandatory Course- HRM360, HRM370, HRM380.
Additional Course- HRM410, HRM430, HRM460, HRM480, HRM490.
(U have to do any 3 course from here for major & 1 for minor).
#MKT = (Prerequisite MKT202)
Mandatory Course- MKT337, MKT344, MKT460, MKT470.
Additional Course- MKT382, MKT412, MKT417, MKT445, MKT450, MKT465, MKT480.
( U have to do any 2 course from here for major).
#INB = [Prerequisite INB372 (old name MGT372)]
Mandatory Course- MKT382, FIN444, INB480.
Additional Course- ECO 328, FIN445, INB350, INB355, INB410, INB440, MKT417.
(U have to do any 3 course from here for major & 1 for minor).
#MIS = (Prerequisite MIS105 & MIS205)
Required Course- MIS210, MSI310, MIS450, MIS460, MIS470, MIS480
(U have to do all 6 course from here for major & no option for minor).
#ECO Major= Mandatory Course: ECO 203, 204 ,303, 304, 249, 372 + Any 3 four level courses and any 2 three level courses for major. In total 11 courses for major.
#ECO MINOR: Mandatory Course, ECO- 203,204 & 249 + any 3 major courses from Economics major.
#INTERNSHIP/ RESEARCH (4 credit): U can do intern if u complete 60 credits. U can take 2 courses along with internship.
#Open_electives- If u do single major than u will get 5 open electives and if u do single major & minor u will get 1 open elective. U can do any courses under open elective as long as this course is accepted by BBA program.
#For_Concentration U have to do 11 courses from that major including mandatory major courses.
#MAT-112 and #ENG-102 is a mandatory credit course whoever gets one of these or both have to do this/those & will be counted. MAT-112 is a mandatory credit course from 102 Batch.
#ENG-102 is a mandatory credit course from 101 Batch.
Who got 60% or above marks in undergraduate admission test don’t get any one of this. For those who got less than 60% marks in admission test (MATH) get MAT-112. For those who got less than 60% marks in admission test (ENG.) get Eng-102. MAT-116 is for other Departments students not for BBA students. Sometimes when faculty finds mat-112 section full they give mat-116 to BBA students in that case u can do it.
#MAJOR DECLARATION: To declare a major U must need a CGPA of 2.5 in that major. If u have less 2.5 in major than u will count as BBA GENERAL means no major.
#GRADUATE DECLARATION: To declare Urself as a graduate u must have a CGPA OF 2 in Core
